title: 城市苏醒时
logline: 六个无旁白空镜完整呈现城市从沉睡到醒来的过程，最终落定品牌唤醒用户的清晨场景

shots.visual: Wide shot of a dormant city at 5:30 AM, dark skyscrapers with only scattered lit windows, empty streets under dim streetlights
Medium shot of white steam rising slowly from a street sewer vent, drifting over the wet empty pavement
Close-up of the illuminated subway entrance, electronic sign flashing 'First Train Arriving', faint steam curling out of the tunnel
Long shot of the city skyline against the gradually brightening dawn sky, shifting from deep indigo to soft orange as building outlines become clearer
Tracking shot of the first subway train gliding into the empty station, interior lights turning on, doors opening to reveal a few early commuters
Close-up of the digital screen inside the subway train, displaying the brand logo and slogan 'Start Your Urban Morning' as the train departs
